svg.title: Exhaustive Indian DC value chain universe — sub-segments and tiers
svg.desc: Five layers split into 18 sub-segments. Each row shows the Indian listed companies in that sub-segment grouped into Tier A (already run 3x+), Tier B (picking up), and Tier C (yet to be discovered) columns. Private and pre-IPO companies appear in italic at the bottom of the Tier C column. Companies are placed in their primary sub-segment only.
svg.text: italic in Tier C column = private / pre-IPO (catalyst marker, not investable today)
